items.title: Veo 3.1 Ingredients to Video: More consistency, creativity and control
items.summary: Our latest Veo update generates lively, dynamic clips that feel natural and engaging — and supports vertical video generation.
items.summaryZh: Google DeepMind发布了Veo 3.1版本，重点提升了视频生成的表现力与一致性。新版本支持原生垂直视频（9:16）输出，并提供最高4K分辨率的画质增强，旨在优化移动端短视频创作体验。原始信息显示：Our latest Veo update generates lively, dynamic clips that feel natural and engaging — and supports vertical video generation.。该消息由Google DeepMind发布，主题为“Veo 3.1 Ingredients to Video: More consistency, creativity and control”。其重要性主要体现在：Google DeepMind更新了其视频生成模型，增强了移动端创作能力与垂直视频支持。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

items.title: Zenken boosts a lean sales team with ChatGPT Enterprise
items.summary: By rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise company-wide, Zenken has boosted sales performance, cut preparation time, and increased proposal success rates. AI-supported workflows are helping a lean team deliver more personalized, effective customer engagement.
items.summaryZh: Zenken通过全公司部署ChatGPT Enterprise，成功优化了销售工作流，显著缩短了准备时间并提高了提案成功率。该案例体现了AI在提升企业销售团队人效方面的实际价值。原始信息显示：By rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise company-wide, Zenken has boosted sales performance, cut preparation time, and increased proposal success rates. items.title: Salesforce rolls out new Slackbot AI agent as it battles Microsoft and Google in workplace AI
items.summary: Salesforce on Tuesday launched an entirely rebuilt version of Slackbot , the company's workplace assistant, transforming it from a simple notification tool into what executives describe as a fully powered AI agent capable of searching enterprise data, drafting documents, and taking action on behalf of employees. items.summaryZh: Salesforce推出了全新重构的Slackbot，将其从简单的通知工具升级为具备自主行动能力的AI Agent。该代理能够深度集成企业数据（如Salesforce记录、Google Drive文件等），并代表员工执行复杂任务。此举是Salesforce在企业级AI代理市场中对抗微软与Google的重要战略布局，旨在将Slack打造为“代理化企业”的核心入口。
